since.title: Since
since.description: Only actions proposed at or after this (epoch seconds); null for all time.

total.title: Total
total.description: Every action counted, whatever its status.

pending.title: Pending
pending.description: Waiting for a PIN, and not yet expired.

cancelled.title: Cancelled
cancelled.description: Dropped by someone before it ran.

ActionCounts.title: ActionCounts
ActionCounts.description:
Proposed actions by status, over all time or since a moment.

A proposal past its expiry counts as expired, never pending, here as in
every list.

ActionEvent.title: ActionEvent
ActionEvent.description: An action was proposed. It waits for a PIN; nothing has run.

reply.title: Reply
reply.description: Ira's answer once the action ran: it saw the result and carried on with what was asked. Show it as Ira's next message.

continued_in_call.title: Continued In Call
continued_in_call.description: The answer is being spoken in the live call instead.

locked_until.title: Locked Until
locked_until.description: When the wrong-PIN lock ends (epoch seconds); null when actions are not locked. locked_seconds is the same moment as seconds from now.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Where it was proposed: web, api or telegram.

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: Who proposed it. Who: the person's email (older rows may hold another name, such as owner or telegram:<name>). Never the channel; that is in channel.

decided_by.title: Decided By
decided_by.description: Who confirmed or cancelled it, from the audit log: an email, as actor.

decided_channel.title: Decided Channel
decided_channel.description: Where it was confirmed or cancelled: web, api or telegram.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: 2: needed a "yes" from the person who asked; 3: a PIN. null for actions stored before tiers (they needed a PIN).

device_id.title: Device Id
device_id.description: An action on someone's own device. Unless it is yours, its params, summary and result are hidden.

status.title: Status
status.description: pending, executing, executed, failed, cancelled or expired.

confirm_roles.title: Confirm Roles
confirm_roles.description: The roles that may confirm this action: actions.tools.<name>.confirm_roles in ira.yaml, or else actions.confirm_roles.

can_confirm.title: Can Confirm
can_confirm.description: Whether the caller may confirm it: their credential has the actions permission and their role is in confirm_roles. A missing PIN is not counted here; GET /v1/me/pin says that.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: 2: runs on a "yes" from the person who asked (POST /v1/actions/{id}/approve, or yes typed or spoken in the same conversation). 3: needs a PIN (POST /v1/actions/{id}/confirm).

can_approve.title: Can Approve
can_approve.description: Tier 2 only: whether the caller is the person who asked, and so may say yes.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Where you asked: web, api, telegram.

device.title: Device
device.description: The device's name, for a device tool.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: 0 read, 1 small and undoable, 2 needed a yes, 3 needed a PIN.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: ok or error (it ran); proposed (it waited for a yes or a PIN); refused (content from a device or the web asked for it); executed or failed (it ran after the confirmation).

ActivityRow.title: ActivityRow
ActivityRow.description: One thing Ira did for you: a tool it used or an action that ran. Never its content.

id.title: Id
id.description: The session's id (ses_...). Not a credential.

current.title: Current
current.description: True for the session making this request.

user_agent.title: User Agent
user_agent.description: The browser's User-Agent at sign-in, cut to 200 characters; null when none was sent or the session is older than this field.

device.title: Device
device.description: A short label read from user_agent on the server, such as "Chrome on macOS", "Safari on iPhone" or "curl"; null when there is no user_agent to read.

role.title: Role
role.description: That user's role now: owner, admin, staff or viewer.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: Actions it has run so far.

minutes.title: Minutes
minutes.description: How long a PIN on screen control covers; 0 is off.

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id

action.description: An action proposed in this turn, waiting for the PIN.

arguments.title: Arguments

ok.title: Ok
ok.description: False when the call failed: arguments that were not valid JSON or did not fit the tool's schema, an unknown or switched-off tool, or an error from the tool. Proposing an action is ok.

result.title: Result
result.description: The result the model was given, as text (usually JSON), cut to its first 500 characters. Errors read {"error": "..."}.

truncated.title: Truncated

actor.title: Actor

available.title: Available

may_do.title: May Do

actor.title: Actor

tier.title: Tier

pin.title: Pin

channel.description: Where it started: web, api or telegram.

user_id.description: Whose it is; null for rows from before accounts.

preview.title: Preview

DataDeleted.title: DataDeleted
DataDeleted.description: What "Delete my data" removed. Your account stays; an owner can remove it.

token.title: Token
token.description: irad_ and 32 random bytes. Keep it in the Keychain or Keystore.

name.title: Name
name.description: What its user calls the assistant.

DevicePaired.title: DevicePaired

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: 0 read, 1 small and undoable, 2 needs a yes, 3 needs a PIN.

on.title: On
on.description: Its skill is switched on, so Ira may use it.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: The skills to have on: the whole list.

pin.title: Pin
pin.description: Your action PIN; needed only to switch a skill on.

version.title: Version
version.description: The client's version, from its hello.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: The tools its last hello offered (kept while it is offline).

DeviceView.title: DeviceView
DeviceView.description: A paired device. Never its token, and never anything it returned.

model.title: Model
model.description: provider:model that answered; null if none did.

message_id.title: Message Id
message_id.description: The stored answer's id, for POST /v1/me/feedback.

DoneEvent.title: DoneEvent

description.title: Description
description.description: How to install it, in a sentence.

available.title: Available
available.description: This server has it; else get it from GitHub Releases.

url.title: Url
url.description: Where to download it: here, or the project's releases page.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: A sentence for people; a list of field errors on 422.

ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail

Every error: 400 bad input, 401 no or bad credential, 403 not allowed,
404 not found, 409 conflict, 410 gone, 422 invalid body, 429 too many tries.

ErrorEvent.title: ErrorEvent
ErrorEvent.description: No model could answer. A done event follows.

event.title: Event
event.description: From a device: watch_done, task_progress, task_done or task_failed. From Ira: reminder, nudge, or learning_question (data.learning_id: answer it with approve or reject).

EventView.title: EventView
EventView.description: Something a device announced, such as a watched tab that finished.

message_id.title: Message Id
message_id.description: The answer's message_id, from ask or the done event.

learned.title: Learned
learned.description: True when it was kept: learning and its feedback source are on.

GrantView.title: GrantView
GrantView.description: Something a person allowed Ira to use: a skill on one of their devices, or web search.

browser_stt.title: Browser Stt
browser_stt.description: May the web app recognise speech in the browser: when this server has no speech-to-text (fallback), always (prefer), or never (off).

live.title: Live
live.description: A live call works here (/v1/voice/live): streaming speech-to-text and a voice, and your role may talk to Ira.

mic_language.title: Mic Language
mic_language.description: The language to recognise in the browser, from your languages: hi-IN when you speak Hindi or Hinglish, else en-IN.

token.title: Token
token.description: Shown once. Only its hash is stored.

path.title: Path
path.description: Open this path on the server to accept the invitation.

url.description: The whole link to send: public_url followed by path, when public_url is set; null otherwise (join the server's origin and path yourself).

text.title: Text
text.description: The sentence, reworded. Its numbers must still be in the evidence.

observations.title: Observations

kind.description: time (a routine time), duration, or preference.

text.title: Text
text.description: The sentence, written from the evidence: every number is in it.

status.title: Status
status.description: proposed (not enough evidence yet), ready, asked, active (you said yes), rejected, faded (not seen lately) or changed (the numbers moved).

pin.title: Pin
pin.description: Your action PIN: needed to switch learning or a source on.

on.title: On
on.description: Learning is on for you. Off: nothing new is noticed.

macs.title: Macs
macs.description: Your Macs and whether each one's routine is on.

days.title: Days
days.description: How long observations are kept, in days.

observations.title: Observations
observations.description: How many of each kind are kept.

use_cookie.title: Use Cookie
use_cookie.description: true: an HTTP-only session cookie (browsers). false: the session token in the response body (other clients).

on.title: On
on.description: Its routine skill: lock, sleep, wake and network.

id.title: Id
id.description: The action's id, for /v1/actions/{id}/confirm or cancel.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description: The action tool it would run.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: What it would do, in words written by the tool's code.

status.title: Status
status.description: pending, executing, executed, failed, cancelled or expired. A proposal past expires_at reads expired, never pending.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: When it stops waiting for a PIN (epoch seconds).

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: 2: waits for a "yes"; 3: waits for a PIN.

MessageAction.title: MessageAction
MessageAction.description: The action a tool call proposed, as it stands now (not as it was then).

content.title: Content
content.description: For role tool: the tool's result as JSON text, exactly as the model saw it. A proposal's result always reads pending_confirmation; action has its status now.

tool_call_id.title: Tool Call Id
tool_call_id.description: For role tool: the call this answers.

name.title: Name
name.description: For role tool: the tool's name.

model.title: Model
model.description: For role assistant: the provider:model that wrote it (each tool round can fall back to another). null when no model wrote it (an error or the step limit), for other roles, and for messages stored before this field.

action.description: For a tool result that proposed an action: that action now, with its current status. null for every other message, and for a proposal stored before this field whose action could not be matched.

private.title: Private
private.description: For role tool: a device's output. Only the conversation's own user sees its content; anyone else's transcript shows a placeholder instead.

cooling.title: Cooling
cooling.description: Models on a cool-down: seconds left.

cooling_reasons.title: Cooling Reasons
cooling_reasons.description: For each model in cooling (the same keys): why it is cooling down.

voices.title: Voices
voices.description: Valid voice ids for the text-to-speech provider in use: for polly, its neural voices for en-IN, hi-IN, en-US and en-GB; for openai, the voices every model accepts; empty when text-to-speech is off. A static list; ira.yaml may name others.

id.title: Id
id.description: The conversation_id: send it to /v1/ask to continue.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Where it started: web (signed in) or api (a token).

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: The first thing you said, cut to 120 characters.

MyConversationRow.title: MyConversationRow
MyConversationRow.description: One of the caller's own conversations from the web chat or the API.

assistant_name.description: What you call the assistant; the default is the installation's name.

wake_phrase.description: What your phone listens for (default "Hey Ira"). A phrase of your own needs a wake-word model trained for it.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: The languages you speak to Ira in: en (English), hi (Hindi, in Devanagari or Latin letters) and hinglish.

reply_language.title: Reply Language
reply_language.description: auto: reply in the language you spoke; or always en, hi or hinglish.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: Your time zone (IANA, such as Asia/Kolkata), for your routines and reminders; null: the server's.

MySettings.title: MySettings
MySettings.description: Your own assistant. Each value is yours, or the installation's default.

web_search.title: Web Search
web_search.description: Switch web and news search on (needs pin) or off.

pin.title: Pin
pin.description: Your action PIN; needed only to switch web search on.

MySettingsUpdate.title: MySettingsUpdate
MySettingsUpdate.description: Send only what changes; null goes back to the default.

label.title: Label
label.description: Office, Home: a name, never an address.

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint
fingerprint.description: A salted hash made on the Mac; never the network's name.

label.title: Label
label.description: The name you gave it, such as Office; null until named.

ObservationIn.title: ObservationIn
ObservationIn.description: A phone's place event. A place's name only: anything else in the body is refused.

recorded.title: Recorded
recorded.description: False when learning or the phone source is off.

since.title: Since
since.description: The server's local midnight today (epoch seconds). Every count here is since this moment, in the server's time zone (timezone), not the viewer's.

since_iso.title: Since Iso
since_iso.description: since as ISO 8601 with the server's UTC offset, e.g. 2026-10-12T00:00:00+05:30.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: The server's time zone: an IANA name such as Asia/Kolkata when the system names one, else its UTC offset such as +05:30.

questions.title: Questions
questions.description: Questions people asked today, on every channel: the user turns stored since the start of today. A bare PIN typed into chat is never stored or counted.

calls.title: Calls
calls.description: Model calls today. One question can make several (one per tool round), and model tests count too.

failures.title: Failures
failures.description: Model calls today that failed: no model in the chain answered, or a stream broke off.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Actions proposed today, by status. A proposal past its expiry counts as expired, never pending.

Overview.description: Today at a glance. "Today" starts at the server's local midnight: see since.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: The device's kind; must match the code's.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Skills to switch on once it pairs.

pin.title: Pin
pin.description: Your action PIN: pairing a device is a new grant.

code.title: Code
code.description: Eight characters, shown as ABCD-EFGH; type it on the device.

server.title: Server
server.description: The address the device connects to.

pair_url.title: Pair Url
pair_url.description: The link in the QR code: server + /pair#code=...

qr_svg.title: Qr Svg
qr_svg.description: The QR code of pair_url, as an SVG data: URI.

new_password.title: New Password
new_password.description: 10 characters or more. Tell them; they can change it.

can_confirm.title: Can Confirm

pin_set_at.description: When you last set your PIN (epoch seconds). null without a PIN, and for a PIN set before IRA recorded this.

pin_min_length.title: Pin Min Length
pin_min_length.description: The fewest digits a PIN may have.

pin_max_length.title: Pin Max Length
pin_max_length.description: The most digits a PIN may have.

in_use.title: In Use
in_use.description: Named by a tier or by voice, so it is built at start-up.

key_present.title: Key Present
key_present.description: Whether the key's variable is set. Never the value.

message_id.title: Message Id
message_id.description: The answer's message_id, from ask or the done event.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: wrong (not true), harmful (dangerous advice), offensive, private (it showed something it should not), or other.

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: The reported answer, up to 2,000 characters.

locked_until.title: Locked Until
locked_until.description: When the wrong-PIN lock ends (epoch seconds); null when actions are not locked. locked_seconds is the same moment as seconds from now.

host.title: Host
host.description: The address `ira serve` bound: its --host, else channels.http.host.

port.title: Port
port.description: The port `ira serve` bound: its --port, else channels.http.port.

public_url.title: Public Url
public_url.description: channels.http.public_url, or IRA_PUBLIC_URL: where people reach the server (for example on a phone, through a TLS proxy). null when not set.

url.title: Url
url.description: The base URL to open: public_url when set, else http://host:port (127.0.0.1 for a wildcard host such as 0.0.0.0).

ServerAddress.title: ServerAddress
ServerAddress.description: Where the server listens, and where people open it.

needs.title: Needs

current.title: Current

ended.title: Ended

setup_code.description: Printed in the server log while no user exists.

on.title: On

offered.title: Offered

shorten.title: Shorten

user_id.description: The account the chat acts as.

password.title: Password

user_id.description: The account the chat will act as.

bot_link.title: Bot Link

TelegramPairing.description: A one-time pairing code. Shown once; only its hash is stored.

user_id.description: Whose account the chat will act as; default you. Someone else's needs the users permission (owner).

token_env.title: Token Env

token_present.description: Whether that variable is set. Never its value.

pairing_seconds.title: Pairing Seconds
pairing_seconds.description: How long a pairing code works.

chats.title: Chats

order.title: Order

configured.title: Configured

chain.title: Chain

token.title: Token
token.description: Shown once. Only its hash is stored.

arguments.description: The arguments the model passed, as a JSON object; {} when they were not valid JSON.

id.title: Id
id.description: The id of the tool event this answers.

ok.title: Ok

result.title: Result

news_ready.title: News Ready
